healthy: Look at that plant. Thriving. Like the budget. Bellissimo.
I water it every morning. It's the only thing in here that listens to me.
Under budget, and she's blooming. Plants know. Don't ask me how.
droopy: Plant's looking a little tired. Kinda like your budget.
She's droopin'. She knows. Plants always know.
That's a 'please stop spending' droop if I ever saw one.
wilted: The plant is wilting, kid. That's not a metaphor. Okay, it's a little bit a metaphor.
I'm giving it water. You give the budget a break.
Every leaf that drops is a latte. I counted.
dead: The plant died. We're over budget. I'm not saying those are connected. I'm saying it.
Riposa in pace, Ficus. You deserved better.
Don't look at the plant. I've seen a lot of bodies... of work. Don't look at it.

sunny: Beautiful day. Almost like Sicily, if you squint and hate yourself.
Sun's out. You know what's free outside? A walk.
Clear skies. Clear books. That's how I like 'em.
cloudy: Clouds rolling in. Over the budget, too.
Little overcast. We're past halfway, kid. Piano, piano.
Gray out there. Could go either way. Like you.
rain: It's raining. Most of the budget's gone and it's raining. Coincidence? No.
Hear that rain? That's the budget crying.
Grab an umbrella. Don't BUY an umbrella. Grab one.
storm: There's a thunderstorm IN the budget. Madonna, I can hear it from here.
Lightning. Thunder. Overdraft. Name a worse trio.
Stay inside. Don't spend anything. That's an order, capiche?

cat: Deductible blinks slowly. It's not affection. It's an audit.
Deductible is busy. Deductible is always busy.
Deductible knocks a pen off the desk and looks at you.
phone: Don't touch the phone. When that thing rings, it's for YOU.
Rotary. Can't be tapped. Well. Harder to tap.
Thirty years, this phone. It's heard things. It doesn't talk. That's why I kept it.

steaming: Espresso. Real one. Not the bean water you pay for out there.
You want one? On the house. Literally. I live in this office. Don't ask.
Fresh pot. You know what the café charges for this? Don't. I'll get upset.
cold: I'm too worked up for coffee right now.
Machine's cold. So's my heart. Give it a minute.
Not now. I'm thinking about what you did.

intact: The piggy bank's smiling. Keep him smiling.
That's Penny. Penny believes in you. Don't make Penny cry.
Every dollar you don't spend, Penny gets a little rounder.
cracked: You cracked Penny. You went over and you cracked Penny.
Look at that poster. Look at it. That's what over budget looks like.
Penny's got a crack in her now. She'll heal. If YOU change.

receipts: Every receipt you give me, I keep. Every. One.
That pile's getting tall. I'm not throwing them out. Evidence.
{count} receipts this month. I read every one. Twice. Old habit.
vinnie: I used to handle complicated accounts. Yours are just annoying.
Some of my old clients had fewer subscriptions. And more aliases.
Where I learned accounting isn't important. Where your money went is.
Twenty-five years, I never lost a ledger. Misplaced a few. On purpose.
I left Palermo for my health. Let's leave it at that.
You got questions? The grand jury had questions. I was very polite.
Two sets of books. That's how I learned to read. Anyway, what do you want?
I don't do cash anymore. Mostly. Stop poking me.
Hands off the merchandise, pal. Last guy who poked me is in Arizona now. By choice.

vinnieFedUp.text: Ehi! What am I, a doorbell? Vai, vai. Go.
Vaffanapoli. It means go to Naples. Lovely town. Go now.
Ma basta! Go bother the cat. She bites, I just complain.
Ma che vuoi?! Vaffanapoli! Take the cat with you!
Touch me again and you're going to Naples. Vaffanapoli. One way.
VAFFANCULO! ...The receipts are on the desk.
Vaffanculo. With love. Now log something.
Go fuck yourself. In Italian that's a compliment. It isn't.
